name: Sonic Attack
description: Sonic Attack lets you use the power of sound waves to damage and weaken your foes.

powers.name: Shriek
powers.description: You let forth a quick Shriek, damaging your target and weakening their Damage Resistance. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Fast

powers.name: Scream
powers.description: Your Scream can cause serious damage to a target, while weakening their resistance to further damage. Damage: Moderate(DoT), Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Howl
powers.description: A short range, but powerful sonic attack. Damage: Medium, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Shockwave
powers.description: You can call forth a tremendous Shockwave that can knock down foes and deal some Smashing damage in a wide cone area. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Shout
powers.description: You blast your foe with a tremendous Shout, damaging them and reducing their Damage Resistance. Damage: High, Recharge: Moderate

powers.name: Amplify
powers.description: Greatly increases the chance to hit of your attacks for a few seconds. Slightly increases damage. Recharge: Long

powers.name: Siren's Song
powers.description: You send forth a subsonic pulse which causes your foes to fall unconscious and take some minor damage. Your foes will remain unconscious for a good while, but will waken if disturbed. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Long

powers.name: Screech
powers.description: By bursting forth with this hypersonic Screech, you can disorient a target. Damage: Minor, Recharge: Slow

powers.name: Dreadful Wail
powers.description: Your Dreadful Wail is so strong that most foes will be defeated by being subjected to it. Dreadful Wail deals Extreme Smashing and Energy damage to all nearby foes in addition to reducing their defense and disorienting them for a good while.  Damage: Extreme, Recharge: Very Long
